text:
rachel: deploy-bot flagged post-canary preflight failure for release payments@v2.3.0 in prod-eu1. Blocking rollout. Error from admission webhook: failed to apply patch — values.payments.db.poolSize type mismatch. logs below.

deploy-bot: PRELIGHT_RESULT: CANARY_FAILED -> BLOCKED. failed checks: CRD-validation, admission-webhook, post-upgrade-health. values hash: 0x7a3b. diff: values.payments.db.poolSize changed from int->string.

alex: ack. can you paste the deploy-bot diff and the pod status? curious if pods OOM/killed or just crashloop due to parse error.

mike: quick checks: canary pods 2/3 restarted. logs show: `panic: unable to parse pg pool size "auto"` from payments-db init. Looks like the chart bumped postgres subchart and now expects integer.

ingrid: if the chart changed values schema, forward rollout could break tenant DB controllers. options: (1) rollback to previous chart v2.2.9 and pin, (2) hotfix values to coerce types (`int`), (3) patch subchart for backwards compat and re-canary. We're inside the 30m change window.

alex: my vote: rollback + hold/pin chart version for this release train, then open PR to normalize values and add CI lint. Safe and quick.

rachel: agree. need release notes + PM/CS heads notified. @deploy-bot can you perform rollback to payments@v2.2.9 in prod-eu1?

deploy-bot: received action request: rollback release=payments namespace=payments cluster=prod-eu1 target_chart_version=v2.2.9. manual approval required from approvers list: alex, sre-oncall.

alex: approving now.

deploy-bot: executing: `helm rollback payments 1 --namespace payments --kube-context prod-eu1`

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK_COMPLETE status=SUCCESS. post-rollback check: `kubectl -n payments get pods` -> 3/3 Ready, all canary checks passed, canary closed.

mike: will open PR with values patch to coerce poolSize to integer or accept both string/int and add unit test. also adding a helm chart-values schema lint step: `ct lint --charts charts/payments --values values/` in CI.

ingrid: I'll add a note to the chart CHANGELOG and mark the chart bump as breaking so we catch it during model onboarding.

rachel: I'll draft a brief announcement for PMs/CS: "Payments rollout for v2.3.0 rolled back due to values/schema mismatch in postgres subchart. We rolled back to v2.2.9 and opened a fix PR; retest in staging after PR approved." Will post in #product and #customer-success.

sre-oncall: 👍 recommend adding an automated schema-check gate on deploy-bot that rejects chart version bumps without values-schema compatibility metadata.

alex: timeline: rollback executed at ts 2364501256, hold pinned until PR merged and we re-run canary.

rachel: thanks everyone — closing thread, will follow up with PR link and release-note draft.
